hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (500 ms budget) the weakest regimes are capacity_level=tight (vbs_rel_gap -22.25%), size=100 (-20.89%), spatial=clustered (-19.23%) and depot_style=eccentric (-19.83%). Because tight-capacity and eccentric-depot instances dominate the loss, a multiplication-based ruin score that (a) strongly gates on route-load saturation (route_loads/capacity) and (b) gates on radial distance from the depot will select ruin sets whose re-insertion by deterministic Regret-2 is much more constrained, yielding larger net tour-length reduction than the plain worst-cost/savings ranking; annealing p with stagnation_ratio should also avoid the R2R stagnation trap within the 500 ms anytime loop. Expected mean objective < 16.0429.

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve the multiplicative gate × rank-power ruin priority score toward a capacity/depot-aware hybrid: keep |removal_savings|/scale as the density-normalized base, but amplify the gate_load term (tight-capacity routes prioritized) and add an eccentric-depot radial gate that favors removing nodes far from the depot centroid, with the rank-power exponent p annealed as a function of stagnation_ratio and iter_frac so that early iterations diversify (broad top-q ruin) and stagnant phases intensify worst-removal.
